payloads.title: Elimination III
payloads.note: A 2000 DirectDraw arena shooter, booted from its own executable. Written for DirectX 3: DirectDraw, DirectSound by ordinal, and DirectInput 3.0.

payloads.title: Cave Story
payloads.note: Studio Pixel's 2004 freeware platformer, booted from Doukutsu.exe with its 400 game files: DirectDraw surfaces, DirectSound, DirectInput, and GDI text through CreateFontA and TextOutA. It renders every music track into PCM before its first screen, so it takes a while to load.
